Rule 1: Everything for the veteran together with the veteran
Rule 2: Want to help - ask if needed.

Business Support Content: Support the veteran community, join the "Khmelnytskyi Grateful" project. The initiative is dedicated to supporting defenders from conscious, socially-oriented business of the Khmelnytskyi urban territorial community. The project provides special discounts and offers for defenders and the veteran community. The goal is to collect information about these companies in one place to make access to current offers simpler and easier.
Population Support Content: The Veteran Space offers training on current topics designed to help civilians understand the importance of supporting veterans. Topics include: veteran policies and programs, features of communication with the military and veterans, specifics of psychological reactions of people with combat trauma, opportunities for veterans and their families in education, employment and starting their own business, the importance of respecting servicemen and veterans, as well as honoring the memory of fallen Defenders for modern Ukrainian society and future generations.
Partners Support Content: The "Veteran Space" is open to cooperation with indifferent entrepreneurs, organizations and institutions that strive to make the community more inclusive for the veteran community, support veterans and their families. Our team is looking for reliable partners to make Ukraine better.
